note: 01-06 are pre-existing hand-written campaigns; this catalog covers 07+ in page order. modes: bounded = exactly-verified bound reachable with today's verifier library; aux = falsification/observation-centric (auxiliaries killable, witnesses verifiable pointwise); search = hunt for a witness/construction, runs full budget (stopOnSuccess false); exploration = grounding/formulations, short runs.

problems.title: Polignac — every even gap 2k occurs infinitely often
problems.statement: Conjecture de Polignac : pour tout k >= 1, il existe une infinité de paires de premiers consécutifs distantes de 2k.
problems.focus: Verifier armory: next_prime_gap(n) is exact. (1) bounded/verified: for each even 2k in a chosen set, the FIRST occurrence of gap 2k below a bound K via worker search + exact-point verification of the witness pair (is_prime on both endpoints); (2) auxiliaries to kill or support: 'every even gap <= 100 occurs below N' (search), density claims, 'record gaps keep growing' statements; (3) source-backed: known record gaps.
questions: First occurrence of each even gap 2k <= 100: verified witnesses?
Which plausible bounds on first-occurrence positions die to exact counterexamples?

problems.title: Nombres premiers jumeaux
problems.statement: Conjecture des nombres premiers jumeaux : il existe une infinité de premiers p tels que p+2 soit premier.
problems.focus: Twin = Polignac k=1. (1) verify the largest twin-free interval structure via next_prime_gap (pointwise verified witnesses); (2) empirical support: twin counts up to 10^7 in worker scripts (numerical-evidence framing); (3) falsify auxiliaries about twin density/monotonicity; (4) source-backed: Zhang/Maynard bounded-gap results.
questions: Verified twin witnesses at interesting scales (10^k)?
Which density monotonicity claims die exactly?

problems.title: Conjecture abc
problems.statement: Conjecture abc : pour tout eps > 0 il existe K_eps tel que pour tous a,b,c premiers entre eux avec a+b=c, c < K_eps * rad(abc)^(1+eps).
problems.focus: No verifier predicate for rad — workers script exact abc-hits (rad via sympy factorization) and register artifacts; individual hit computations can be exact-point verified when expressible; falsify auxiliaries ('abc quality above X exists below Y' searches); source-backed: known abc-hit records.
questions: Largest-quality abc hits computable in budget?
Which qualitative claims about quality distribution die?
